figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of FFM-CP. Frozen pathology foundation models encode the support tiles, class descriptions, atextbfnd query tile. Cross-backbone alignment maps their heterogeneous embedding spaces into a shared reference space. A unified graph then refines support-image, visual-prototype, and text-prototype nodes through seven relation types. Finally, cross-backbone pair fusion evaluates all ordered query–evidence model pairs in separate text and case streams.
